subject: Panasz - készpénzfelvétel hiba a Danubia ATM Pest 12-nél
body:
Tisztelt Bank!

Felháborodva írok Önöknek, mert a mai napon elfogadhatatlan helyzet történt velem. Ügyfélszámom: C-1002. 2026-10-20-án a Danubia ATM Pest 12 automatánál 40 000 HUF készpénzt kívántam felvenni. A gép hangos zajt adott ki, de készpénzt nem adott, ennek ellenére a számlámat megterhelték a 40 000 HUF összeggel.

Ez felháborító! A pénzem nem kaptam meg, mégis levonták. Azonnali visszatérítést kérek a 40 000 HUF összegre, valamint írásos tájékoztatást a hiba kivizsgálásáról. Ellenkező esetben panaszt teszek a felügyeleti szervnél.

Üdvözlettel:
Nagy Péter

draft.body:
Kedves Nagy Péter!

Örömmel tájékoztatjuk, hogy panaszát kivizsgáltuk, és azt teljes egészében megalapozottnak találtuk: a vitatott 40 000 HUF összeget visszatérítjük Önnek. A visszatérítés jóváhagyását követő 1 munkanapon belül kerül jóváírásra a számláján.

A vizsgálat során megállapítottuk, hogy az érintett ATM naplója szerint a készülékben kazettahiba lépett fel, és egyetlen bankjegy sem került kiadásra, így a 40 000 HUF terhelés ellenérték nélkül történt. A vonatkozó szabály szerint, ha az ATM megterheli a számlát, de nem ad ki készpénzt, a terhelt összeget és az esetleges kapcsolódó díjat az ATM naplójának ellenőrzése után visszatérítjük [1]. A napló ellenőrzése megtörtént és megerősítette a hibát. Külön díj nem került felszámításra, mivel a hónap első saját ATM-es készpénzfelvétele díjmentes, ezért a visszatérítés pontosan a vitatott 40 000 HUF összeg [1]. Mivel a hiba a bank oldalán merült fel, a panaszt teljes egészében elfogadjuk [2].

Ha a válasszal nem elégedett, jogorvoslati lehetőségként a Pénzügyi Békéltető Testülethez vagy a Magyar Nemzeti Bankhoz fordulhat (mnb.hu/fogyasztovedelem).

Üdvözlettel:
Danubia Bank Complaints Team

retrieved.title: Danubia Bank – Retail Fee Schedule (Hirdetmény), effective 2026-01-01
retrieved.content: At Danubia ATMs the first two cash withdrawals per calendar month are free. From the third withdrawal in the same month the fee is 0.6% of the amount, minimum HUF 200. At other banks' ATMs the fee is 1% of the amount plus HUF 400. If an ATM debits the account but does not dispense cash, the debited amount and any related fee are refunded after the ATM journal is checked.

retrieved.title: Danubia Bank – Card Disputes and Unauthorised Transactions Procedure
retrieved.content: If a customer reports a card or account transaction they did not authorise, the bank refunds the amount immediately and at the latest by the end of the following business day after the report. The only exception is when the bank has reasonable grounds to suspect fraud by the customer and reports this in writing to the supervisory authority. The refund may not be delayed while the bank investigates the customer's possible negligence; liability is assessed afterwards.

retrieved.title: Danubia Bank – Card Disputes and Unauthorised Transactions Procedure
retrieved.content: Before the loss or theft of the card is reported, the customer may bear losses up to HUF 15,000, unless the transaction was made without strong customer authentication, in which case the customer bears no loss. Online transactions without strong customer authentication (SCA) are refunded in full.

retrieved.title: Danubia Bank – Complaint Handling Policy (internal), v4.2
retrieved.content: A complaint is upheld when the bank made an error; the customer receives a full refund of the amount wrongly charged plus, for errors causing inconvenience, an optional goodwill credit of up to HUF 5,000 at the handler's discretion. A complaint is partially upheld when only some points are justified; only the justified part is refunded. A complaint is rejected when the bank acted in line with the contract and fee schedule; the answer must explain the applicable rule clearly. Any refund above HUF 200,000 or any decision involving suspected fraud must be escalated to the Complaints Team Lead before approval.

retrieved.title: Danubia Bank – Complaint Handling Policy (internal), v4.2
retrieved.content: Answers are written in the customer's language, address the customer by name, state the decision in the first paragraph, explain the reason with reference to the applicable rule, state any refund amount and its value date, and close with how to follow up. Never promise anything beyond the decision recorded by the handler.

retrieved.title: Danubia Bank – Card Disputes and Unauthorised Transactions Procedure
retrieved.content: If goods or services paid by card were not delivered or were materially different from what was ordered, the customer should first contact the merchant. If the merchant does not resolve the issue, the bank initiates a chargeback through the card scheme. The chargeback is not a refund decision of the bank: the outcome depends on the merchant's response, typically within 45 days. The answer to the customer must explain that the chargeback was initiated, what documents are needed (order confirmation, correspondence with the merchant), and the expected timeline.

assessment.rationale: The ATM journal for T-9070 confirms a cassette jam with 0 notes dispensed, so the 40,000 HUF debit was charged without any cash being paid out. Under fee-schedule#3, when an ATM debits the account but does not dispense cash, the debited amount and any related fee are refunded after the ATM journal is checked; the journal check is complete and confirms the failure. No separate fee was charged (first own-ATM withdrawal in the month is free), so the refund is exactly the 40,000 HUF disputed amount. This is a bank error, so the complaint is upheld; no goodwill is added as the policy makes it discretionary and no inconvenience beyond the refund is documented.

state.investigation:
**Factual summary — complaint C-1002 (Nagy Péter)**

- **Customer:** Nagy Péter, ID C-1002, package BASIC, card ending 1177, not flagged as vulnerable.
- **Disputed transaction:** T-9070, dated 2026-10-20, type `atm_withdrawal`, description "DANUBIA ATM PEST 12", amount **−40,000 HUF**, ATM owner: own (Danubia), first withdrawal in the month.
- **ATM journal data on T-9070:** `atm_dispense_status: failed`, note "cassette jam, 0 notes dispensed" — i.e. the record itself confirms no cash was dispensed.
- **Fees:** No separate fee transaction appears for this withdrawal in the 2026-10-18 to 2026-10-22 window. The applicable rule (ATM_OWN) is "first 2 withdrawals per calendar month free, then 0.6%, min HUF 200", so this first-in-month own-ATM withdrawal would not have incurred a fee anyway.
- **No other transactions** were found for this customer in the reported period.

The facts support that the 40,000 HUF debit (T-9070) corresponds to a failed dispense with zero notes paid out. No decision on the complaint is made here.
